title: 1560. Most Visited Sector in  a Circular Track

examples.explanation: The marathon starts at sector 1. The order of the visited sectors is as follows: 1 --> 2 --> 3 (end of round 1) --> 4 --> 1 (end of round 2) --> 2 (end of round 3 and the marathon) We can see that both sectors 1 and 2 are visited twice and they are the most visited sectors. Sectors 3 and 4 are visited only once.
